# apicurio_config_property (Resource)

A dynamic configuration property of the registry, one of those `GET /admin/config/properties` lists (for example the deletion switches `apicurio.rest.deletion.group.enabled`, `apicurio.rest.deletion.artifact.enabled` and `apicurio.rest.deletion.artifact-version.enabled`). The change applies at once. Destroying the resource resets the property to the server's default (its environment variable or shipped default); it does not restore the value found before Terraform managed it. Properties that are not dynamic, such as `apicurio.storage.enable-automatic-group-creation`, can only be set through the server's environment. Needs the admin role on a secured registry. Make the resources that rely on a switch `depends_on` this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Turn the deletion switches on from Terraform; the resources that must be
# deletable depend on them so that the switch is set first.
resource "apicurio_config_property" "delete_groups" {
  name  = "apicurio.rest.deletion.group.enabled"
  value = "true"
}

resource "apicurio_config_property" "delete_artifacts" {
  name  = "apicurio.rest.deletion.artifact.enabled"
  value = "true"
}

resource "apicurio_config_property" "delete_versions" {
  name  = "apicurio.rest.deletion.artifact-version.enabled"
  value = "true"
}

resource "apicurio_group" "payments" {
  group_id   = "payments"
  depends_on = [apicurio_config_property.delete_groups]
}

# Any other dynamic property, as GET /admin/config/properties lists them.
resource "apicurio_config_property" "max_subjects" {
  name  = "apicurio.ccompat.max-subjects"
  value = "5000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the dynamic property. Changing it replaces the resource (the old property is reset).
- `value` (String) Value as a string, checked against the property's `type` at plan time: `true`/`false` for a boolean, a whole number for an integer or long. Stored and compared as written.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description the registry gives for the property.
- `id` (String) The property name.
- `label` (String) Label the registry shows for the property.
- `type` (String) Java type of the property: `java.lang.Boolean`, `java.lang.Integer`, `java.lang.Long` or `java.lang.String`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Properties are imported by name.
terraform import apicurio_config_property.delete_groups apicurio.rest.deletion.group.enabled
```
